items.title: Tyson Q4 earnings: Beef business could return to profit in 2027
items.summary: Al Root, Barron's Associate Editor, joins the 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian, to discuss Tyson Foods (TSN) issuing new guidance that its beef business could return to profitability in fiscal 2027, after losses tied to several factors, including record-high beef prices.

items.title: What Tyson Foods (TSN) Said on Its Q4 Earnings Call
items.summary: Tyson Foods (NYSE:TSN) expects sales to decline in fiscal 2027 as tight cattle supplies and a restructured beef network reduce volume, even as the company projects a substantial improvement in its beef business. items.title: Tyson Foods Soars 9% on Q4 Beat as Beef Losses Look Set to Ease in Fiscal 2027
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTyson Foods jumped 9% today on a fourth-quarter beat and a better beef outlook. Tyson sees beef anywhere from a $300 million loss to a $100 million profit in fiscal 2027, and JBS’s beef margin has turned positive.
